schema_explanation.edge_direction: A node points to the premises/proof tasks required by its displayed selected sufficient rule.
schema_explanation.AND: All requires entries are required by that complete displayed rule. It is sufficiency, not necessity.
schema_explanation.LEAF: A proved certificate or an exact remaining opaque producer/implication task. Open leaves are not asserted true by this audit.
schema_explanation.implication_certificate: A completed conditional argument. It proves only its arrow; it does not supply its antecedents.
schema_explanation.implication_reconstruction_task: The remaining B/C human proof of a precisely stated source implication; included separately so its inputs are not falsely treated as already sufficient in the human manuscript.
schema_explanation.work_refinements: Nonlogical shared work or partial source expansion. No subset or conjunction here is asserted to produce the consumer.
